privileged_info_for_vlm: The policy update requires the following specific values: General Shift must be 08:00 to 18:00. Annual Leave (AL) must be set to 16 days. Sick Leave (SL) must be set to 8 days. A new leave type 'Wellness Day' must be created with code 'WD' and 2 days entitlement. The workweek must be updated to include Friday as a weekend/non-working day.
